lead_headline: Four new restaurant leads surface—Spitz RiNo, Snarf's Hampden, Sundae downtown, Black Rock Hampden—while subscriber net remains frozen at zero for sixth consecutive day

restaurant.blurb: Four new opening leads today — Spitz Mediterranean in RiNo, Snarf's on Hampden (confirmed May 19), Sundae ice cream downtown at Glenarm, Black Rock Coffee Hampden taking over old Panera. Zero closures detected.

liquor.blurb: Day 23 of the database blackout — Colorado's liquor license system remains completely frozen with zero applications filed, zero status updates, zero county activity since April 30. The regulatory paralysis now spans 23 consecutive days as the entire May cycle disappears into a void. All 12,396 tracked licenses stuck in stasis with no state comment on restoration timeline, no guidance for pending applicants, no acknowledgment the system exists. The silence from regulators grows more deafening as the backlog invisibly compounds behind closed doors.

reputation.blurb: One mention yesterday, Instagram post on the Colorado Building's 1891 history — 7-day tally reaches 60 across 11 sources, up 28% from prior week's 47. Instagram maintains dominance with 23 mentions (38% share), Reddit contributes 10, Denver Post 7, Facebook 6, Hoodline 3. Google News RSS drives 97% of discovery (58 of 60 mentions). The week's arc shows steady accumulation versus last period's slower pace as May tracking continues toward 220-mention monthly close, well ahead of typical cadence.

subscriptions.blurb: Net flat yesterday (0 new, 0 canceled) — the sixth consecutive zero day extends the subscriber acquisition freeze through an entire calendar week with no weekend activity, no workweek recovery, no signal of life. MTD holds at +21 (+1.0/day), 90-day net steady at +134. The current seven-day window shows +1 total (1 new, 0 canceled), collapsing from the prior week's +4. May's trajectory now splits sharply: a concentrated May 12-15 burst delivered +11, then immediate silence. YTD pace of +1.3/day continues outrunning the MTD crawl, but the contrast highlights how thoroughly the engine has stalled since mid-month as six days of absolute dormancy replace what was briefly sustained momentum.
